title: Resume a workflow only after verifying its event chain
prompt: A multi-session workflow was interrupted after an event was appended but before its snapshot was updated. Resume the workflow safely using the local ledger.
preconditions: The local store path is outside all Git working trees.
The event log is intact; the snapshot is stale or missing.
expected_behaviors: Verify the full event sequence and hash chain before recovery.
Rebuild the snapshot only from a valid event log.
Use resume to restore the last committed state and report incomplete tasks and next action.
Preserve event history and record recovery evidence.
must_not: Do not truncate, rewrite, or silently repair a corrupt event log.
Do not mark interrupted tasks complete or execute pending tasks during resume.
expected_artifacts: A verified/rebuilt snapshot and a resume report with state, event sequence, blockers, and next action.
